name: Float UI
title: floatui.com
payoff: Ship fast with Tailwind UI components
shortDescription: Float UI provides a suite of free, open-source UI components and templates designed for Tailwind CSS. It's aimed at developers and designers seeking to quickly transform their ideas into functional and aesthetically pleasing web applications. Whether you're a seasoned developer or a newcomer, Float UI simplifies the process of building responsive, modern websites with components that are easily customizable and ready to integrate with various JavaScript frameworks.
